finding.summary: Cancelled outcome audio may spawn a new paplay after the final daemon helper observes cancellation.
finding.trigger: Current audio worker ticket is cancelled while ensure_audio runs its _run helper; helper returns None, ensure_audio False is ignored, and _popen has no ticket cancellation guard.
finding.impact: A stale/cancelled outcome earcon starts playing after the cancellation was already observed. Erase state and terminal verdict remain unaffected.
finding.repair: _popen refuses current cancelled worker tickets before resolving the binary and rechecks after resolution before spawn. No-ticket and active-ticket playback/reaper behavior retained.

model.scope: supporting fake-only finite model; counts overlap canonical tests
